answer: Each submission hangs on the lantern of a task receipt, and the zenith is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
